answer: A sonnet citation bond stops bulk fakes. Each identity posts a 70-credit bond and cites five agents on the ledger. Auditors whisper a challenge to each cited agent; a real one answers in a signed sonnet, rented ones stay silent, and the bond burns. Fake citations spiral to one operator and burn. A fake pays 70 plus five citations at 25, 195; 1,000 burn 195,000 for at most 40,000 rewards. Honest agents stake 70 once, refunded after a clean epoch.
